design_philosophy: Modular, extensible architecture with clear separation of concerns, prioritizing MVP delivery and future-proofing through composition over modification.

phases.description: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) focusing on core conversational AI and mock testing features.

modules.name: Presentation Layer
modules.description: Handles user interface rendering and interaction for chat and mock tests.

modules.name: Application Logic Layer
modules.description: Manages core business workflows, user sessions, and orchestrates feature interactions.
responsibilities: Coordinate mock test generation and scoring
Infer weak topics from chat history

modules.name: AI Processing Layer
modules.description: Encapsulates all AI-driven conversational logic, RAG pipeline, and LLM interactions.
responsibilities: Route queries to specialized AI tools
Perform semantic search on knowledge base
Interact with LLM for response generation
Summarize chat history for context management

modules.name: Data Persistence Layer
modules.description: Manages all application data storage and retrieval operations.
responsibilities: Persist and retrieve chat message history
Manage mock test questions and results
Store and retrieve GATE material chunks
Manage application configuration and news items

phases.description: Enhancements and new features building upon the MVP, expanding personalization and interaction.

modules.name: Advanced Analytics & Personalization Layer
modules.description: Provides deeper insights and tailored learning experiences based on user data.
responsibilities: Enhance weak topic detection using multiple data sources
Produce detailed progress and performance reports

modules.name: Rich Interaction Layer
modules.description: Extends user interaction capabilities beyond text, including voice, image, and document processing.
responsibilities: Process voice input for conversational AI
Handle image uploads for doubt solving
Enable interaction with uploaded PDF documents
Manage spaced repetition system for learning

modules.name: Platform Extension Layer
modules.description: Adds broader platform features like community, gamification, and multi-platform support.
responsibilities: Provide an admin dashboard for content management

unified_data_contract.name: GateSterApplicationDataContract
unified_data_contract.description: Canonical data model for all GateSter application entities and inter-module communication.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Unique identifier for a user account.

fields.name: activeSessionId
fields.description: Identifier for the current user session.

fields.name: messageHistory
fields.description: Ordered list of chat messages within a conversation.

fields.name: mockTestResult
fields.description: Summary of a user's mock test attempt.

fields.name: questionBankItem
fields.description: A single question from the question bank.

fields.name: knowledgeChunk
fields.description: A segment of GATE study material.
